article.title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
article.summary: The new ads will begin to appear later this month in the U.S. only for now, and will feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers.

all_candidates.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
all_candidates.summary: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.
